caseName: E.P.A. v. Eme Homer City Generation, L.P.
caseNameFull: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY v. EME HOMER CITY GENERATION, L.P.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granted limited to the questions presented by the petition in No. 12-1182. The case is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
